subject: Trading
title: Leverage: The Double Edge
description: A quick win: understand Leverage: The Double Edge.

hook.text: Forex brokers offer 50:1 leverage. A $2,000 account controls $100,000. Gains are magnified—so are losses.

buildup.text: A 1% move against a 50:1 leveraged position wipes out 50% of your capital. Two percent and you're done.

discovery.text: Leverage is how forex brokers make small price changes meaningful—without it, currency moves would be too small.

twist.text: Most retail forex traders lose money. Studies show 70-80% of accounts are unprofitable—leverage is the main accelerant.

climax.text: Leverage doesn't change your edge. It only amplifies the outcome—profit or ruin—at the same rate.

punchline.text: Leverage makes winners richer and losers broke faster.

quiz.question: What percentage of retail forex traders are typically unprofitable?
